title: Upper bound for character expectation
statement: Let $n,\ell$ be natural numbers with $\ell>0$, choose an irreducible monic binary modulus of degree $\ell$, and let $\gamma$ be a nonzero binary vector of length $n$. The expected Walsh character of the generated output, with both length-$\ell$ seeds chosen uniformly, is at most $n/2^\ell$.
hypotheses_covered: The implementation has an irreducible monic binary modulus of degree $\ell$
